headline: Four. The cover holds.
body: Fifteen degrees under the same mostly cloudy sky, wind light from the west-southwest. Streets stay dry; Sunday traffic thins toward evening. Light remains low and even, no thinning in the cover.

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: dry; late Sunday afternoon traffic light

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: four o’clock; sun still held, diffused
